value.rationale: The exact all-arity type enumerator, equivalently total pattern popularity within the layered class, completely characterizes a natural logical-extension equivalence relation: all ordered layer-size compositions of fixed (n,k) are indistinguishable even across every tuple arity. Meanwhile just two counts recover (n,k) without being given n, and the sharp first same-size failure at three named points and first unary cross-size collision make the reconstruction phenomenon mathematically precise. These distinctions are not consequences of the familiar global count 2^(n-1) alone.
